name: print-social-tech-nology-week-facebook-post-purple-black-vr-photo
title: 'Tech Nology Week' Facebook post with a purple-black grid pattern and a VR headset photo shattering into pixels
whatItMeans: Energetic and eye-catching; the shattering pixel effect on the VR photo makes a generic tech event feel cutting-edge.
whatItIs: A wide purple-bordered post split into a black-and-purple diagonal grid pattern with the word 'TECH' broken across a line, a mustard 'HITECH' logo tag, and a photo of a man in a VR headset with a particle-shatter effect breaking off his hand.
techniques: Split a headline word awkwardly across a line break for graphic effect.
Add a particle-shatter effect to a photo for a tech, digital feel.
Use a diagonal grid pattern with hatching as background texture.

vocabulary.definition: A photo edge breaking into small floating fragments.
A background texture of angled lines and hatching.
